passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()

venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=password_by_app['venmo'])
simple_note_token = simple_note_login['access_token']
venmo_token = venmo_login['access_token']
print({'simple_note_login': simple_note_login, 'venmo_login': venmo_login})

from datetime import datetime
current_datetime = datetime.now()
dinner_notes = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query='dinner', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    dinner_notes.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print({'current_datetime': current_datetime.isoformat(), 'dinner_notes': dinner_notes})
